triad.what: Cognition, reasoning, learning. Models of the world and of the self.
The nervous system. Timing, sensing, coherence, and transport.
Embodiment. Action in the physical and simulated world.

ayeai.invariant: Remove any one element and intelligence collapses. Together they form a living loop.

panels.title: Highest-level picture
panels.text: Humanesque estate → epistemological ground → FAKIR → domainal formation / navigation → Varzish → Mahajanapad. Sovereignty, plurality, equity.

panels.title: Humanesque estate
panels.text: Constitutional and civilizational envelope. Central concern is the sovereign human, not a profession, culture, modality, technology or AI model.

panels.title: Epistemological dukedom
panels.text: A dukedom is a sovereign domainal/epistemological configuration. FAKIR retrieves the domainal ground from which it can be constituted.

panels.title: FAKIR — the guide
panels.text: Retrieve, don't reconstruct. Must not generate, assume, classify, assign.

panels.title: What FAKIR retrieves
panels.text: ISIC economic activity, ISCO occupation, ISCED education, plus other erudition. Domain-space: activity × work × learning × erudition.

panels.title: FAKIR × PEDLER
panels.text: FAKIR: what/where. PEDLER: how it moves. Dynamic walk: state, observation, evaluation, inclination, selection, act, execution, new state.

panels.title: FAKIR × ILM
panels.text: ILM: how it is represented. Multiple languages and modalities can represent the same semantic state.

panels.title: Abdication
panels.text: Dukedom → abdication → dormant/suspended sovereignty (not destruction). The dukedom can re-arise when called forth.

panels.title: Post-identity
panels.text: Not 'who am I?' but 'what is my mission?' A sovereign need not have one domain.

panels.title: FAKIR → Varzish
panels.text: Practice / development environment: traditions, techniques, institutions, knowledge, cycles, reflection.

panels.title: Mahajanapad
panels.text: Many sovereigns, one civilizational space. Interoperability without homogenization.

panels.title: CHARBAGH
panels.text: Humanesque triage and wayfinding. Arrive, elicit, retrieve, map, navigate, compose, derive, enter, remember.

panels.title: Derivative estates
panels.text: Declare intent, retrieve with FAKIR, correlate, human review, constitute estate, enter Humanesque. Canonical example: BAZMI.

panels.title: Zistgah estate
panels.text: Infrastructure / ecosystem for enabled agency. Living ecosystem where enabled agency is instantiated and sustained.

panels.title: AyeAI triad
panels.text: Irreducible causal loop: AyeAI (think) · AyeAM (embody) · AyeCNSe (sense/coherence). Removing any member collapses the loop. LIVE.

panels.title: Foundry
panels.text: Realization infrastructure. Executable ontology. Foundry is not a member of the triad; it enables the triad.

panels.title: AyeAI × Humanesque
panels.text: Different axes, can intersect. Humanesque answers sovereign human/civilizational questions. AyeAI addresses computational/cognitive realization.

panels.title: CEM
panels.text: Substrate realization coordinate. FAKIR→domain, ILM→representation, PEDLER→dynamics, CEM→realization.

panels.title: Cycler substrate
panels.text: Common execution/orchestration protocol. A cycler is a programmable lifecycle: intent, structure, design, test, package, preserve. PANINI is the whole-structure language with ILM/Hindawi as deeper substrate.

panels.title: Six modality cyclers
panels.text: MATBA press · KHWAB visual · AWAZ audio · TILASM immersive · PENCH embodied · YADEIN record.

panels.title: GENIE
panels.text: Meta-cycler / creative agency. Conceptualize, drive, orchestrate, compose, elevate, descend, split, merge.

panels.title: GENIE five coupled loops
panels.text: Creative cognition; affective-aesthetic regulation; experience-learning; memory reconstitution; embodiment-action.

panels.title: GENIE two complementary loops
panels.text: Operational (discover→specify→formalize→implement→verify→refine) and creative. Complementary, not competing.

panels.title: Creative state (PCS)
panels.text: Persistent creative state: unified semantic world, structure, narrative memory, creative identity, world model.

panels.title: Convergence in GENIE
panels.text: GENIE × FAKIR × CHARBAGH × cyclers. Convergence creates architecture.

panels.title: GENIE × FAKIR × CHARBAGH
panels.text: FAKIR retrieves domain; CHARBAGH routes; GENIE conceives.

panels.title: FAKIR × CHARBAGH × GENIE
panels.text: Mission → retrieve → route → conceive → cyclers / estate / derivation.

panels.title: GENIE × Varzish
panels.text: Practice environment under GENIE drive.

panels.title: Provenance and configuration
panels.text: Misty DOI, OTS, configuration management. Deliverable semantics.

panels.title: Deliverable semantics
panels.text: Typed lifecycle objects with status, version, provenance.

panels.title: PANINI as whole-structure language
panels.text: PANINI with ILM/Hindawi as deeper linguistic/semantic substrate. This tree.
